PropertySetDef.Name: Pset_WindowPanelCommon
PropertySetDef.Definition: Definition from IAI: Properties common to the definition of all IfcWindowPanel.

PropertyDef.Name: FrameToLiningOffset
PropertyDef.Definition: Offset measured horizontally (perpendicular to the panel and glazing plane) between the inner surface of the frame and the inner surface of the lining.

PropertyDef.Name: StileDepth
PropertyDef.Definition: Depth (dimension in plane perpendicular to glazing) of the stiles dividing any glass panes

PropertyDef.Name: StileThickness
PropertyDef.Definition: Thickness (width in plane parallel to glazing) of the stiles dividing any glass panes

PropertyDef.Name: CrackLength
PropertyDef.Definition: Length of the joints of this window panel (usually the perimeter of the panel) that have to be considered for natural ventilation and heat losses.

PropertyDef.Name: InfiltrationCoefficient
PropertyDef.Definition: Infiltration Coefficient per length unit of joints. Used in conjunction with the LenghtOfJoints property in Pset_WindowPanel or Pset_DoorPanel.. The usual unit (if pressure is taken into consideration) is m3/(mhPa2/3). The following translations apply: G: Fugendurchlaskoeffizient, J: JYOINTO BUBUN NO KUUKI TOUKARITU

PropertyDef.Name: GlazingAreaFraction
PropertyDef.Definition: Fraction of the glazing area relative to the total area of the filling element. It shall be used, if the glazing area is not given in the Pset_DoorWinPanelOpening as OpeningArea. The following translations apply: G: Glasflachenanteil, J: MADO MENSEKI HIRITU
